description: Platform-agnostic primitives with no external integration. FFIR itself depends on these, so every target must implement all of them.

capabilities.description: Splits execution down one path or another. The condition lives on each outbound edge, so a compound test is a chain of these rather than a nested boolean tree.

case_sensitive.description: Compare string operands case-sensitively. Turn off when matching user-entered text such as an email address or a status word.

capabilities.description: Iterates over a collection. Edges from the each port form the body and the last body node connects back to this node; the done port continues after iteration finishes.

items.description: An expression naming the collection to iterate over.

item_alias.description: How the current item is referenced inside the body, as {{ <this node id>.<alias>.<field> }}.

max_iterations.description: Hard upper bound on iterations. An unbounded loop is a validation error: it is the failure mode that burns a client's task quota on a metered platform.

batch_size.description: How many items to hand the body per iteration.

capabilities.description: Rejoins branches into one stream. Inbound edges are ordered by source node ID, so the merged result is deterministic.

mode.description: How to combine the inbound streams. Append concatenates them, combine joins them on matching fields, and choose_branch passes through whichever branch produced data.

combine_by_fields.description: Field names to join on. Needed only when mode is combine.

items.description: One field name present on both inbound streams.

capabilities.description: Reshapes data by assigning named fields from literals or expressions. Pure: it has no side effects. Expressions carry no arithmetic, so anything needing real computation becomes an assignment here.

assignments.description: The fields to set. Assigning no fields is a validation error rather than an identity step.

field.description: The name of the field to write.

value.description: The value to write, as a literal or an expression template.

include_other_fields.description: Pass upstream fields through alongside the assignments. Turn off to emit only the assigned fields.

capabilities.description: Pauses the workflow for a fixed duration before continuing.

duration_seconds.description: How long to pause, in whole seconds. Platforms disagree about sub-second precision, so this is seconds rather than milliseconds.
